C0291.title: When Verification Codes Became a Harassment Tool: Who Was Behind It?
C0291.summary: In May 2023, police in Suining, Sichuan, arrested a suspect surnamed Xiong. Investigations revealed that Xiong modified SMS bombing source code obtained online, hijacked registration interfaces of multiple commercial websites to control their SMS verification platforms, and developed a program called 'Super SMS Bomber' capable of continuously sending verification code messages to a specified phone
